% Caption kept here, deliberately not typeset - the figure carries a
% number only.  To restore it, move the line below into \caption{}.
% QQ plots of winning probabilities at the stable equilibrium before the rise in noise ($\sigma_1=0.9$, opportunity cost $OC_1=0.2758$) and at the stable equilibrium reached after it ($\sigma_2=2.25$, $OC_2=0.2448$), under a convex mills ratio. The opportunity cost is not held fixed, so the top curve starts, and the regular curve ends, off the $45^{\circ}$ line. Each program meets its payline before and after, so each curve crosses the line once: low ranked top applicants lose and low ranked regular applicants gain. $F$ standard logistic; $G=\mathrm{Beta}(2,2)$ on $[-2.5,2.5]$; $\lambda^T=0.3$, $\lambda^R=0.57$, $v^R/v^T=0.35$, $c/v^R=0.4$.

% QQ plots of winning probabilities at the stable equilibrium before the rise in noise ($\sigma_1=0.3$, opportunity cost $OC_1=0.2382$) and at the stable equilibrium reached after it ($\sigma_2=0.6$, $OC_2=0.2609$), under a concave mills ratio. The opportunity cost is not held fixed, so the top curve starts, and the regular curve ends, off the $45^{\circ}$ line. Each program meets its payline before and after, so each curve crosses the line once: low ranked top applicants gain and low ranked regular applicants lose. $F$ standard logistic; $G$ exponential with rate $1.5$ truncated to $[-2.5,2.5]$; $\lambda^T=0.3$, $\lambda^R=0.583$, $v^R/v^T=0.3$, $c/v^R=0.4$.
\caption{Concave Mills Ratio, Before and After the New Equilibrium}
\label{fig:qq_eq_concave}
\end{figure}
